baselines: Last3: empirical distribution and mean of player points in up to last3 prior GWs; position pool fallback if none
Shrink5: same prior player history, shrunk with fixed5 pseudo-observations from the prior-position empirical pool
data: Current official historical outcomes, strictly target GW excluded; not independently timestamp-certified historical label vintages
parameter_choice: Window3 and prior strength5 are fixed here, not tuned on GW8/9
scoring: Mean forecasts use MSE; distributions use proper CRPS; MAE is secondary
scope: Research benchmark, not a feature ablation or a replacement model
